parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ directory — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplicate 'DebugMetricsProvider.init' at line 82 of DebugHUD.swift is a local convenience initializer written for the sample app's debug HUD overlay, not a production artifact. Lifting the production initializer in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' into shared code on the basis of this match would couple the DebugPanel package to sample-app semantics, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
